title: Gastric / Esophageal Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for upper gastrointestinal (gastric/gastroesophageal-junction and esophageal) cancer. Captures primary site and, for gastric disease, resectable vs metastatic setting, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. HER2 / MSI / PD-L1 testing further individualise metastatic therapy and are considered separately. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Gastric / Esophageal and Esophagogastric Cancer; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Gastric / Esophageal cancer. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Primary site
nodes.title: Primary site
nodes.description: Gastric / gastroesophageal-junction and esophageal cancers follow related but distinct pathways.

nodes.name: Gastric setting
nodes.title: Gastric setting
nodes.description: Resectable gastric/GEJ disease is treated with peri-operative or adjuvant chemotherapy (curative intent); metastatic/unresectable disease is treated with palliative intent, individualised by HER2/MSI/PD-L1.

nodes.name: Resectable gastric
nodes.title: Resectable gastric/GEJ: peri-operative or adjuvant chemotherapy
nodes.description: Peri-operative FLOT or adjuvant capecitabine-oxaliplatin (after D2 resection). Physician selects; the existing dose engine computes doses.

nodes.name: Metastatic gastric
nodes.title: Metastatic gastric/GEJ: chemotherapy (+ immunotherapy if eligible)
nodes.description: Fluoropyrimidine-platinum chemotherapy; add pembrolizumab for PD-L1-CPS-positive (HER2-negative) or MSI-high disease. HER2-positive disease adds trastuzumab (considered separately). Physician selects.

nodes.name: Esophageal
nodes.title: Esophageal: chemoradiation / adjuvant immunotherapy
nodes.description: Neoadjuvant chemoradiation (CROSS) for locally-advanced resectable esophageal cancer; adjuvant nivolumab for residual pathologic disease after neoadjuvant chemoradiation and resection. Physician selects.
